interpretation.terminology: Every original 3/4 perspective note means the explicitly requested parallel 2/3 view, not a vanishing-point view. Original review text is preserved verbatim below.
interpretation.orientation: A South-facing request means the actual front plane faces the viewer with zero camera yaw, not that the old oblique source is retained. Preserve the explicitly requested East profile for Clara dining-chair.
interpretation.camera: Keep an elevated top/front camera and visibly deep top surfaces. Rectangular near/far widths stay equal and depth lines parallel. Circular horizontal surfaces use coherent flattened ellipses, approximately 0.5–0.6 when appropriate to the physical shape; no universal depth ratio is forced on all objects.
interpretation.shapeAndIdentity: Preserve native detail, motifs, colors, natural curves and physical asymmetry, including Miles curved cases, Chopin crests, Zizi leaf forms, tub rims and carved chair arms. Do not replace them with generic rectangles.
interpretation.integration: Use one uniform contain scale for each new crop inside the unchanged world canvas, aligned to its existing bottom center. Do not stretch a corrected source back into the old draw aspect ratio.
